title: Is This Ontario Restaurant Serving up Ghosts?
excerpt: The only time I couldn’t explain a ‘paranormal’ experience
content:
The only time I couldn’t explain a ‘paranormal’ experience

4 min read

11 hours ago

--

There was a knock on the bathroom stall door as clear as day. I was behind the door.

“I’m busy in here!” I said.

But after a few moments, the knock came again. This time, I got annoyed, suspecting it might’ve been one of my co-workers pranking me. We were gathered at the pub for a going-away party for a work colleague. I was in the bathroom stall to quietly prepare a gift for him.

I peered over the stall door. No one else was in the bathroom. I even checked for feet in the other stalls when I came out to investigate. The blood drained from my face.

“You look like you’ve seen a ghost,” joked someone from our group when I re-joined the long table. I didn’t see a ghost, but did I just get punked by one? I briefly told the story over the chatter at the dining table, but the others were dismissive or asked how much beer I had consumed.

My heartbeat was in my throat.

A ghostly woman and a mysterious child
